note: ENA Portal API metadata only (2026-09-27); no FASTQ bytes fetched here. Qualification (check_spacer / strand pilot) still to run once tests/fixtures/prepare_tagseq_public.py has downloaded the pinned runs.

downsample.method: reservoir sampling, pure Python stdlib (no seqtk)

QuantSeq FWD.protocol_excerpt: 200ng RNA input from each sample was used with Quantseq 3' mRNA-seq Library Prep Kit FWD (Lexogen, SKU:015.24)

acceptance_criteria.strand_pilot: featureCounts -s 1 assigns more reads than -s 2 on a pilot STAR BAM (kit is forward-stranded)

backup_candidate.reason_not_primary: same lab/kit (QuantSeq 3' mRNA-seq Library Prep Kit FWD, Lexogen), but Heart/Neural-Tube x WT/STAG2-KO gives 4 groups of 3 in one study; primary needed only 2 groups so PRJNA631146's exact 2x3 design was simpler to wire up.

QuantSeq REV.protocol_excerpt: The libraries were prepared using Lexogen QuantSeq 3' mRNA-Seq Library Prep Kit REV according to manufacturer's protocol.

acceptance_criteria.strand_pilot: featureCounts -s 2 assigns more reads than -s 1 on a pilot STAR BAM (kit is reverse-stranded)

backup_candidate.reason_not_primary: same lab/kit/protocol (nuclear-fraction 3' mRNA-Seq REV) run across 4 cell lines x 3 reps (12 samples); primary study's 2-group design (MIAPaCa2 vs PANC1, 3 reps each) is the minimal 6-run fit the task asked for.

QuantSeq FWD-UMI.protocol_excerpt: library preparation using QuantSeq 3' mRNA-Seq V2 Library Prep Kit FWD with UDI 12 nt (Lexogen) in combination with UMI Second Strand Synthesis Module for QuantSeq FWD (Lexogen)

acceptance_criteria.umi_spacer_check: check_spacer(fastq_gz, umi_len=6, spacer='TATA', reads=10000, minimum=0.8) on each run's raw FASTQ, before any trimming

QuantSeq FWD-UMI.note_on_group_selection: Study has 2 groups (DTA, S100A4) x 5 replicates each; 3 of the 5 replicates per group were pinned to match the 6-run/3-per-group shape. ERR16149162/163 (DTA) and ERR16149167/168 (S100A4) are the two dropped replicates per group, available if more depth is wanted later.

backup_candidate.reason_not_primary: confirmed UMI Second Strand Synthesis Module for QuantSeq FWD, but design is a multi-genotype x multi-treatment panel (C176F/G245S x DMSO/N3a, 3 reps each); primary's plain 2-group x N design needed no sub-selection logic.

backup_candidate_2.reason_not_primary: confirmed UMI Second strand synthesis module for QuantSeq FWD, but design crosses 5 mice x 2 doses x 4 timepoints (irradiated tumour organoids); usable but needs a 2-factor design collapse to pick 2 comparable groups.

rejected_candidates.reason: protocol text names Lexogen 3' QuantSeq REV exactly, but library_layout is PAIRED (brief prefers single-end) and sample_title is an anonymized 'Sample N' series with no group/condition label recoverable from ENA metadata alone.

protocol text names 'QuantSeq REV kit from Lexogen GmbH', mouse, single-end, but sample_title values ('1985i_S6', '1985L_S49', ...) encode an internal animal/tissue code with no decodable group label, and appear to pair with an unlabelled 4sU-labelling design (matching the run count and naming style of the neighbouring PRJNA566003 SLAM-seq study).

protocol text names QuantSeq FWD, human, single-end, 3 biological replicates stated in free text ('Experiment was conducted in three biological replicates'), but sample_title is anonymized 'Sample N' with no group encoded, so group membership is not inferable from ENA fields without pulling the ArrayExpress/BioSample XML out-of-band.
72 mouse runs but every sample_title is 'Sample N' (anonymized); rejected for the same reason as PRJEB84131.
false positive: protocol text contains the substring 'umi' only inside the word 'Illumina'; actual kit is plain QuantSeq FWD (Lexogen #015), no UMI Second Strand Synthesis Module mentioned.
same 'Illumina' false positive as PRJEB65357; kit is plain QuantSeq FWD.
same false positive, this time from 'albUMIn' (BSA) in the cell-sorting buffer recipe; kit is plain QuantSeq 3' mRNA-Seq Library Prep Kit FWD (Lexogen #015), not the UMI module.

protocol names QuantSeq 3' mRNA library prep kit REV, but organism is Saccharomyces cerevisiae and library_layout is PAIRED; yeast has an Ensembl genome/GTF but paired-end was deprioritized versus available single-end mammalian alternatives.
IP/input CLIP-style design (pum IP/input x w118 IP/input), Drosophila melanogaster, PAIRED; not a plain biological-replicate comparison and paired-end, deprioritized.
